{"reason":"Change the medium/high fallback from supplier switching to alert-planner. At $35,000 versus $45,000 with guaranteed timely arrival, this eliminates the four stockouts and lowers projected cost from $2,165,000 to $1,225,000; the 2.8-day and 5.3-day medium failure rows both rely on late alternatives.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else
     (list 'monitor))))"}
